subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-party, vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide after the JetPack setup guidance is corrected?
rationale: The diff is docs-only, but it adds a new first-party hardware install surface adjacent to a recently rejected commercial hardware listing, so scope acceptance cannot be decided by automation alone.

options.title: Accept vendor-neutral guide after repair
options.body: Fix the NVIDIA setup guidance and keep commercial turnkey hardware references out of the page before maintainer merge review.

options.title: Route Jetson hardware docs outside core
options.body: Close or pause this PR and ask contributors to keep Jetson-specific setup in vendor, ecosystem, or ClawHub-adjacent docs.

options.title: Narrow to generic ARM hardware guidance
options.body: Replace the Jetson-specific page with a smaller generic ARM/edge note if maintainers want less hardware-specific first-party coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept vendor-neutral guide after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the NVIDIA setup guidance and keep commercial turnkey hardware references out of the page before maintainer merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: Most relevant history combines the current docs rewrite and VISION/core-docs boundary policy.
